corpus.order_format: LEu64 permutation: physical position to original source ordinal

selection.seed_derivation: SHA256 UTF-8 seed text; entire digest as unsigned big-endian integer
selection.rule: random.Random(seed_integer).sample(range(population_size), 64); map ranks through ascending eligible half-open intervals; preserve sampled order
selection.failure_policy: STOP whole fixed panel on any duplicate or exclusion failure; never replace or resample

prior64_vector_hashes.normalized_hash_dtype: little-endian f64; normalized signed zero canonicalized
